translation.name: Lologena Wo Kienane Yesu Kristo Kome Kewo

book.name: Nakilologianega
book.title: NAKILOLOGIAENA Nap̃a Yoane Pisuia Ana Siriyuia

content: Narin Sipsip amio la nap̃a atol manu yam ponotia taaga lualima yam vari pa vari [144,000]

Nekira ke sina pa yam tai, nom̃al tavie nae Saeon m̃eke ga vamon inu, a ma e luasa nom̃al Narin Sipsip sum̃al sike ea, naga amio kiena pupia p̃ina na yeririna tai. La asiri kiena kia amio kia kiena ne arimana Ntewa sike e piamenala, a la moki pap̃isi, kana marana tol manu yam ponotia taaga lualima yam vari pa vari [144,000].
Ana pupia m̃aagena tai kom ma e peni pitomi, taulu nap̃a sive p̃anpo e piam̃e pona polilu tera. Ana nemiagogonia, nemloge ga nap̃a am̃e kita la amiyelu,

a la asum̃al asike vamon yo wa, e marana ne yar mal la vari nene amio nasumonena lala, amiyaun ke yauena viu tai. La tap̃ena la mokliu nap̃a akekaran yauena nene pap̃isi, la sinelan m̃ena asape ayaunia, ana akilayon p̃elea. La ga nap̃a akilia ayaunia, nane p̃ina na manu yam ponotia taaga lualima yam vari pa vari nene, nap̃a apul plan la petan yomarava rui.

La ke nap̃a pe akilali re piowa amio sira yam tai poli. La apuarar ruru kiela malena mekik ruru po silaga, a ataveve ke Narin Sipsip nene va e yo nape nap̃a naga va ea. Yeririna la mokliu nap̃a asike ne, ana la ke nap̃a apul plan la petan tap̃ena la narui, a la akilala apim sane mras p̃esa nalaena va Ntewa amio Narin Sipsip.
La nene pe visokanen re tai molue kome logola poli, pe sur viowa re nena tai sike e kiela malena poli.
Navisi la telu

Ana e poglis nene, nom̃al navisi tai mom̃a kaka ke e yo punu ga ma metava. Amla lologena wo nap̃a ve uro re pania, vena naga kilia va lologon va e yo punu ga va yeririna na yomarava lala, vena va tol purvanua make ga, yolai make ga, a visena make ga.
Naga pisawal ke pa e yo punu ga amio pulgona nap̃a keviu, sape

content.text: komin nap̃a kiena aora na lip̃ereen yomarava m̃alivi rui.
Alotun naga nap̃a sii sinapane, yomarava, a sive amio purp̃es nen wii lala.”

content: Ana siraun na nene, navisi nalua taveve pimi nap̃a naga piovion ke sape

content.text: “Pupia pulkumali viowa nap̃a P̃apilon naga mlor rui!
Naga pa mla ntewa nap̃a pe pe lelaga re poli, a p̃ere plan yeririna mokliu nap̃a apa ape wowe amio, la sa ga yar na ve torogen ga lala.
Nanagane, pupia pulkumali nene pimi piowa rui amio kiena nono lala.”

content: A yam si tai, navisi na telu taveve la pimi, pisawal manenea sape “Yoko yar la ve moki nap̃a akinai vena alotun yar mali viowa amio kiena nono, a yoko yar la ve moki nap̃a atam̃an awe kiena tatu se piamenala pona limala.

content.text: Ana yar nap̃a kila sanene, yoko naga m̃ena ga mun e piala nap̃a pulen kuruta namunena nap̃a melkalka na pupia sinemimiena kiena ne Ntewa. Yar na sanene, mapulukapi luamene lege kare tasnena e marana navisi wa lala a e marana Narin Sipsip.

Ponoyom̃e na kiela naloge viowaena yoko molue lue e kapi nap̃a tap̃atete mare pog tai. La nap̃a amlotun ke Sur mal Viowa, apatanon kiena nono, amio la nap̃a ap̃ar ke tatu na kiena kia e tasnela, la tap̃atete atol yo wo na va ruru laena, ana yoko ayum̃aen ga loge viowaena ko legiena a kolemalo nalue ga narui.”

content: Nakoaena nini nap̃a navisi pisa m̃arera pap̃isi, ana kana kinasa sape ita li nalelagaena wa lala monar tesum̃alu m̃arera temio kieta sitomena viayavi. Monar telogear navisaluaena lala kiena ne Ntewa, a silaga monar teve lelaga e Yesu.

Ana nemloge visena tai molue ma e peni, sape “Nanene visena tai nap̃a yoko osirilua, nap̃a sape, siar nagane vano, la nap̃a yoko amare, nap̃a kiela malena su ruru sike e limana Sup̃e rui, yoko awar pupia navisa ruruena.” Visena nene p̃isi, ana nemloge Ninuna tam̃ania, sape “Ee, la nene yoko kiela yum̃aena wo la avam metava amio la, a nagane yoko tap̃atete si ayum̃ae narui, la atol kiela navaruruena wo rui.”
Navisi la telu apito ap̃ar kinanena nap̃a marua e yomarava nini

Nekira si pano, ana lul yuwowo tai m̃eke ga vamon inu, ana nom̃al yar tai, sane Narin Yeririna, totano teke e lul nene rui. Totano teke amio karo na p̃arila kiena ne p̃arin sup̃e lala e p̃arina, nap̃a amiyum̃aen e kol, a e limana tarar ke uknaep tai nap̃a mal pap̃isi vena teen kras nen kinanena lala.

Ana navisi tap̃ena molue e yum̃a wa, pio ke nap̃a teke tano e wos nen lul nene, sape “Poga, osum̃alu, otar kiom̃a playu ova osiar yum̃aena. Kinanena la nap̃a sike e yomarava amarmarua rui, nagane pogos na teen narui.”
Ana nap̃a teke tano e lul sum̃alu, silin kiena playu pa e yo kar ga e yomarava, te kinanena la nap̃a marua sike ea.
Ana navisi tap̃ena molue e yum̃a wa ma e peni, nap̃a naga m̃ena p̃arar ke kiena playu nap̃a pe uk, naga m̃ena mal na mal.

Ana navisi ke sina tai pitomi, naga nap̃a pe navisuaren pulukapi, ana naga p̃aro e wonta pimi pio tap̃ena nap̃a mlarar ke playu, sape “Pogaga, ko m̃ena ga, pogos nap̃a oto okila kiom̃a narui. Otar kiom̃a playu oto owar punu kilis nen kerep la nene teliv e yomarava nini viora, ote polo mras la nap̃a marua telan sike e kilisa.”
Ana navisi nap̃a mloge, teran kiena playu e yomarava, pito p̃arpolo mras nen kilkerep e yomarava, koven la e lele na winplanen was nela nap̃a asike vanua e pulkumali.

Ana nasinemimiena kiena ne Ntewa kilapel la ga, pumumu kare la pano-o kuruta mlau p̃arpoyo, mlau pimi keviu sa ga womie, kokonia make purvanua wetelu merorol pa tol kolmekin yaru, pano pano kilamarala plasania.
